exposure: Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate (TDF) use in mothers with hepatitis B
outcome: Mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) rate of hepatitis B
cohort: 342 pregnant women with hepatitis B infection from 2018 to 2020 in Thailand
finding: The overall MTCT incidence rate of hepatitis B was 0.88%, with 0.69% among TDF-exposed infants and 1.02% among non-exposed infants, but no significant association was found between TDF use and MTCT.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an infant factor but no specific weight range provided
